title: How Much of Canada's Trash Gets Diverted, Really #shorts
summary: In 2022 Canada diverted 27.1% of its solid waste and sent 72.9% to disposal (ECCC). Paper led diversion at 3.6 million tonnes, more than a third (Statistics Canada); about 9% of plastic thrown away is diverted (ECCC).
sources: In 2022, 27.1% of solid waste generated in Canada was diverted and 72.9% sent for disposal (9.9 of 36.5 million tonnes); paper 3.571 million tonnes of diverted material; over 3 million tonnes of plastic are thrown away by Canadians each year but only 9% get diverted (Environment and Climate Change Canada, Solid waste diversion and disposal indicator, updated 28 Nov 2024): https://www.canada.ca/en/environment-climate-change/services/environmental-indicators/solid-waste-diversion-disposal.htm

9.9 million tonnes of waste diverted in Canada in 2022; paper fibres up to 3.6 million tonnes, more than one-third of all diverted materials (Statistics Canada, StatsCAN Plus, Less diversion and more non-residential sources push Canada's waste disposal to new high in 2022): https://statcan.gc.ca/o1/en/plus/6850-less-diversion-and-more-non-residential-sources-push-canadas-waste-disposal-new-high-2022
